upstreamManifest: ASSET-MANIFEST.json describes the supplied web reference, not the native runtime bundle.

font.modifications: None. Embedded in the executable and registered in process memory only.

icons.modifications: SVG curves are sampled into GDI polylines. Artwork geometry is otherwise unchanged; semantic color, display size, round caps and joins are applied at runtime.

colors.modifications: The supplied framework's semantic mappings are preserved without changes.
